async def act(page):
    # Search for issues with 'better' in the title
    # Locate the search group within main using accessibility roles
    search_group = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('group').filter(has=page.get_by_role('button', name='Toggle history'))
    # Get the textbox within this group
    search_textbox = search_group.get_by_role('textbox')
    await search_textbox.fill('better')
    # Click the Search button
    search_button = search_group.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to update after search
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now, find all issue links under main that have 'better' in their name (case-insensitive)
    issue_links = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='better')
    # Count how many issue links are found
    count = await issue_links.count()
    if count == 0:
        # If no issues found, raise an error as per task assumption
        raise Exception('No issue with "better" in title found')
    else:
        # Get the first issue link, which should be the latest due to default sorting
        issue_link = issue_links.first
    # Click the issue link to open it
    await issue_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to the issue page
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
